question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. U has an exam on Wednesday. Exactly 4 people have an exam between Q and V, neither of whom has an exam on Monday. P has an exam immediately before S, and R has an exam immediately after S. T has an exam immediately before Q. How many people have an exam before Q?
solution:
Given: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

1) U has an exam on Wednesday.
